## What changed per file

- **cart/editor/shell/regions.ts** — new; the table above plus region map diagram and content rules in comments.
- **cart/editor/workspace.cls.ts** — every region dimension now reads REGIONS (HW_Chrome:21, HW_BuildDock:37, HW_DialogScrim:77, HW_LeftRail:93, HW_SidePanel:97, HW_ToolOptions:206, HW_RightPanel/HW_RightRail:424/430, HW_MenuDropdown top:532); grid columns from REGIONS.grid (HW_ReadRow:447, HW_FormLabel:449, HW_OvBtn/Val/Toggle/Reset:454–469 — bool toggle now spans the exact stepper-block width so all override rows share one control column); never-wrap law baked into headers/labels/button texts (`noWrap` + `numberOfLines:1`, loud `…` truncation — lines 33–34, 99, 152, 169, 191–192, 199, 445, 449, 451); new HW_VerbRow/HW_VerbPrimary/HW_VerbFixed/HW_VerbText (149–152) and HW_InspectorBodyFixed (429, overflow hidden).
- **cart/editor/library/ModelPaintVariants.tsx** — rebuilt on the grid: header row carries title + count only (no more mid-word "PAINT VARI/ANTS" wrap); save verbs moved to a dedicated verb row (Update flexes to the one right edge, fixed 56px New column; labels single-line — the two-line "Update Painting N" chip is gone); variant list is a bounded nested ScrollView (explicit height, ≤4 rows of 34px, `variantListHeight()` at top); row action buttons switched to fixed 22px HW_IconMiniButton columns.
- **cart/editor/stage/ModelOutliner.tsx** — fixed 27px rows with fixed 20px (REGIONS.grid.stepBtn) verb columns (eye at start, duplicate/delete at the end edge); part list is a bounded nested ScrollView with explicit height (`partListHeight()`, cap 10 rows) replacing the maxHeight:300.
- **cart/editor/inspector/Inspector.tsx** — MODEL FOCUS branch now uses HW_InspectorBodyFixed (no whole-panel scroll; sections are budgeted slices with their own nested scrolls); the 3× duplicated pane rail deduped into one `FocusRail` (top of file).
- **cart/editor/inspector/PieceBody.tsx** — PLACE readout sized to its fixed column ("click the map to place"); slot/override rows inherit the grid via cls.
- **cart/editor/inspector/OverrideField.tsx** — doc header documenting the column contract (all dimensions flow from REGIONS.grid via cls; reset end column always reserved).

## Verification (self-shots, never desktop)

- `RJIT_MODELDOC=cube ./tools/rjit shot editor --out …/scratchpad/regions_3.png --frames 30` → PASS. Confirmed: PAINT VARIANTS header single-line with count at right; "Save Painting" verb row full-width single line; variant card one baseline (name left, 327px right, fixed icon columns); OUTLINER fixed rows with aligned end verbs; region geometry unchanged (chrome/browser/panel/status all at prior sizes).
- `./tools/rjit shot editor --out …/scratchpad/regions_4.png --frames 30` → PASS (world/BUILD branch, panel crop `regions_4_panel.png`): label column consistent, all values on one right edge, no wrapped labels. (`regions_1/2.png` are the pre-fix-iteration equivalents.)

## AppFrame follow-ups needed

**None required** — AppFrame mounts regions purely through the cls classifiers, which now read REGIONS; no AppFrame edit was needed for this pass.

## Follow-ups in files I don't own (not edited)

1. `cart/editor/inspector/ReadOnlySection.tsx` — append a reserved end spacer (`<C.HW_OvResetIdle />` after the value) so read-row values share the exact right edge with override/slot rows (currently 26px right of them).
2. `cart/editor/library/ModelDetailBody.tsx` — give ATLAS SETS the same bounded-list treatment; it's now inside the non-scrolling MODEL FOCUS body and a many-atlas model would clip.
3. World-branch focus panel still whole-panel-scrolls (HW_InspectorBody) — full compliance needs paging/budgeting of the override groups.
4. `workspace.cls.ts` HW_StatusBar (28, unused leftover — the live status bar is HW_BuildDock) is a deletion candidate once confirmed dead everywhere.

No blockers.</result>
